## Overview

This notebook validates that simulating a birth-death process with a single birth
and death rate agrees with simulating the same process over three epochs when the
birth and death rates are identical in each epoch.

## Setup

```{python}
# ruff: noqa: E402
# inf_bp_texts must be imported before jax so its JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu default
# (see src/inf_bp_texts/__init__.py) takes effect before jax reads the env var.
```

## Simulate Age Vectors

```{python}
num_sims = 10000
birth_rate = 0.005
death_rate = birth_rate - 0.004
time_span = 1500.0
seed = 42
population_bin_width = 100

single_epoch_birth_rates = birth_rate
single_epoch_death_rates = death_rate
single_epoch_times = time_span

three_epoch_birth_rates = np.array([birth_rate, birth_rate, birth_rate], dtype=float)
three_epoch_death_rates = np.array([death_rate, death_rate, death_rate], dtype=float)
three_epoch_times = np.array([500.0, 1000.0, 1500.0], dtype=float)


def sample_age_vector_process(
    br: np.ndarray | float,
    dr: np.ndarray | float,
    span: np.ndarray | float,
    seed: int,
) -> np.ndarray:
    simulated_df = simulate_birth_death_process(
        birth_rates=br,
        death_rates=dr,
        times=span,
        random_seed=seed,
    )
    survivors = simulated_df.surviving_manuscripts
    assert survivors is not None
    if survivors.empty:
        return np.array([], dtype=np.float64)

    spine_ages = survivors.loc[survivors["is_spine"], "age"].to_numpy(
        dtype=np.float64,
    )
    non_spine_ages = survivors.loc[~survivors["is_spine"], "age"].to_numpy(
        dtype=np.float64,
    )

    if spine_ages.size > 0:
        return np.concatenate([spine_ages[:1], non_spine_ages]).astype(np.float64)
    return non_spine_ages.astype(np.float64)


single_epoch_seeds = derive_worker_seeds(seed, num_sims)
three_epoch_seeds = derive_worker_seeds(seed + 100_000, num_sims)

single_epoch_start = time.perf_counter()
list_of_ages_single_epoch = Parallel(n_jobs=-1)(
    delayed(sample_age_vector_process)(
        br=single_epoch_birth_rates,
        dr=single_epoch_death_rates,
        span=single_epoch_times,
        seed=single_epoch_seeds[i],
    )
    for i in range(num_sims)
)
single_epoch_seconds = time.perf_counter() - single_epoch_start

three_epoch_start = time.perf_counter()
list_of_ages_three_epoch = Parallel(n_jobs=-1)(
    delayed(sample_age_vector_process)(
        br=three_epoch_birth_rates,
        dr=three_epoch_death_rates,
        span=three_epoch_times,
        seed=three_epoch_seeds[i],
    )
    for i in range(num_sims)
)
three_epoch_seconds = time.perf_counter() - three_epoch_start


def sample_age_vector_lifespans(
    br: np.ndarray | float,
    dr: np.ndarray | float,
    span: np.ndarray | float,
    seed: int,
) -> np.ndarray:
    simulated_df = simulate_birth_death_lifespans(
        birth_rates=br,
        death_rates=dr,
        times=span,
        random_seed=seed,
    )
    survivors = simulated_df.surviving_manuscripts
    assert survivors is not None
    if survivors.empty:
        return np.array([], dtype=np.float64)

    spine_ages = survivors.loc[survivors["is_spine"], "age"].to_numpy(
        dtype=np.float64,
    )
    non_spine_ages = survivors.loc[~survivors["is_spine"], "age"].to_numpy(
        dtype=np.float64,
    )

    if spine_ages.size > 0:
        return np.concatenate([spine_ages[:1], non_spine_ages]).astype(np.float64)
    return non_spine_ages.astype(np.float64)


lifespan_seeds = derive_worker_seeds(seed + 200_000, num_sims)

lifespan_start = time.perf_counter()
list_of_ages_lifespans = Parallel(n_jobs=-1)(
    delayed(sample_age_vector_lifespans)(
        br=three_epoch_birth_rates,
        dr=three_epoch_death_rates,
        span=three_epoch_times,
        seed=lifespan_seeds[i],
    )
    for i in range(num_sims)
)
lifespan_seconds = time.perf_counter() - lifespan_start

population_sizes_single_epoch = np.asarray(
    [len(ages) for ages in list_of_ages_single_epoch],
    dtype=np.int64,
)
population_sizes_three_epoch = np.asarray(
    [len(ages) for ages in list_of_ages_three_epoch],
    dtype=np.int64,
)
population_sizes_lifespans = np.asarray(
    [len(ages) for ages in list_of_ages_lifespans],
    dtype=np.int64,
)

rows = []
for method_name, ages_list, population_sizes in [
    (
        "single-epoch process",
        list_of_ages_single_epoch,
        population_sizes_single_epoch,
    ),
    (
        "three-epoch process",
        list_of_ages_three_epoch,
        population_sizes_three_epoch,
    ),
    (
        "lifespan-at-birth (3 epoch)",
        list_of_ages_lifespans,
        population_sizes_lifespans,
    ),
]:
    rows.append(
        {
            "method": method_name,
            "n_sims": int(len(ages_list)),
            "mean_population": float(np.mean(population_sizes)),
            "extinct_fraction": float((population_sizes == 0).mean()),
            "mean_age": float(
                np.nanmean(
                    [
                        float(np.mean(ages)) if len(ages) else np.nan
                        for ages in ages_list
                    ]
                )
            ),
        }
    )

summary_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)

print(f"Simulations per method: {num_sims}")
print(f"Sampling time (single-epoch process): {single_epoch_seconds:.2f}s")
print(f"Sampling time (three-epoch process): {three_epoch_seconds:.2f}s")
print(f"Sampling time (lifespan-at-birth): {lifespan_seconds:.2f}s")
print(
    f"Theoretical extinct fraction: {calculate_extinction_pr(birth_rate, death_rate, time_span):.3f}"
)
print(summary_df.to_string(index=False, float_format="%.3f"))
print(
    f"\nSingle-epoch spine ages count: {sum(1 for ages in list_of_ages_single_epoch if len(ages) > 0 and ages[0] < time_span)}"
)
print(
    f"Three-epoch spine ages count: {sum(1 for ages in list_of_ages_three_epoch if len(ages) > 0 and ages[0] < time_span)}"
)
print(
    f"Lifespan spine ages count: {sum(1 for ages in list_of_ages_lifespans if len(ages) > 0 and ages[0] < time_span)}"
)
print(
    f"Single-epoch non-spine ages count: {sum(len(ages) - 1 for ages in list_of_ages_single_epoch if len(ages) > 1)}"
)
print(
    f"Three-epoch non-spine ages count: {sum(len(ages) - 1 for ages in list_of_ages_three_epoch if len(ages) > 1)}"
)
print(
    f"Lifespan non-spine ages count: {sum(len(ages) - 1 for ages in list_of_ages_lifespans if len(ages) > 1)}"
)
```

## Population Distribution

```{python}
population_max = int(
    max(
        population_sizes_single_epoch.max(),
        population_sizes_three_epoch.max(),
        population_sizes_lifespans.max(),
        1,
    ),
)
population_bin_edges = np.arange(
    0,
    population_max + population_bin_width,
    population_bin_width,
    dtype=np.float64,
)
if population_bin_edges[-1] < population_max + 1:
    population_bin_edges = np.append(
        population_bin_edges, population_bin_edges[-1] + population_bin_width
    )
population_bin_centers = (population_bin_edges[:-1] + population_bin_edges[1:]) / 2.0

population_empirical_counts_single, _ = np.histogram(
    population_sizes_single_epoch,
    bins=population_bin_edges,
)
population_empirical_counts_three, _ = np.histogram(
    population_sizes_three_epoch,
    bins=population_bin_edges,
)
population_empirical_counts_lifespans, _ = np.histogram(
    population_sizes_lifespans,
    bins=population_bin_edges,
)

population_support = np.arange(0, population_max + 1, dtype=np.int64)
population_pmf = np.asarray(
    jnp.exp(
        calculate_populations_log_pmf(
            birth_rates=jnp.array([birth_rate]),
            death_rates=jnp.array([death_rate]),
            ns=jnp.array(population_support, dtype=jnp.float64),
            times=jnp.array([time_span]),
        )
    )
)

population_theoretical_counts, _ = np.histogram(
    population_support,
    bins=population_bin_edges,
    weights=population_pmf * num_sims,
)

_pop_records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
for bc, cnt_s, cnt_t, cnt_l in zip(
    population_bin_centers,
    population_empirical_counts_single,
    population_empirical_counts_three,
    population_empirical_counts_lifespans,
):
    _pop_records += [
        {
            "bin": float(bc),
            "count": int(cnt_s),
            "method": "Observed (single-epoch process)",
        },
        {
            "bin": float(bc),
            "count": int(cnt_t),
            "method": "Observed (three-epoch process)",
        },
        {
            "bin": float(bc),
            "count": int(cnt_l),
            "method": "Observed (lifespan-at-birth)",
        },
    ]
_pop_df = pd.DataFrame(_pop_records)
_theory_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "bin": population_bin_centers.tolist(),
        "count": population_theoretical_counts.tolist(),
    }
)

_pop_color = alt.Scale(
    domain=[
        "Observed (single-epoch process)",
        "Observed (three-epoch process)",
        "Observed (lifespan-at-birth)",
    ],
    range=[PTOLQUAL[0], PTOLQUAL[2], PTOLQUAL[3]],
)
_pop_bars = (
    alt.Chart(_pop_df)
    .mark_bar(opacity=0.65)
    .encode(
        x=alt.X("bin:Q", title="Population size", scale=alt.Scale(domain=[0, 2000])),
        y=alt.Y("count:Q", title="Count"),
        xOffset="method:N",
        color=alt.Color(
            "method:N", scale=_pop_color, legend=alt.Legend(title=None, orient="top")
        ),
    )
)
_theory_line = (
    alt.Chart(_theory_df)
    .mark_line(
        point=alt.OverlayMarkDef(size=25, color=PTOLQUAL[1]),
        strokeDash=[4, 2],
        strokeWidth=2,
        color=PTOLQUAL[1],
    )
    .encode(x=alt.X("bin:Q"), y=alt.Y("count:Q"))
)
fig_population = (_pop_bars + _theory_line).properties(
    title="Population Distribution: Single-Epoch vs Three-Epoch vs Lifespan-at-birth",
    width=600,
    height=350,
)
display(fig_population)
save_chart(
    fig_population, "vme01_population_distribution", width=300, height=200, output_dir=figures_dir
)
print("Saved population figure")
```

## Spine and Non-Spine Age Checks

```{python}
spine_age_samples_single = np.asarray(
    [
        arr[0]
        for arr in list_of_ages_single_epoch
        if len(arr) > 0 and arr[0] < time_span
    ],
    dtype=np.float64,
)
spine_age_samples_three = np.asarray(
    [arr[0] for arr in list_of_ages_three_epoch if len(arr) > 0 and arr[0] < time_span],
    dtype=np.float64,
)
spine_age_samples_lifespans = np.asarray(
    [arr[0] for arr in list_of_ages_lifespans if len(arr) > 0 and arr[0] < time_span],
    dtype=np.float64,
)
spine_age_samples_all = np.asarray(
    [arr[0] for arr in list_of_ages_single_epoch if len(arr) > 0]
    + [arr[0] for arr in list_of_ages_three_epoch if len(arr) > 0]
    + [arr[0] for arr in list_of_ages_lifespans if len(arr) > 0],
    dtype=np.float64,
)
spine_prop_not_at_max = proportion_not_at_upper(spine_age_samples_all, time_span)

non_spine_age_samples_single = (
    np.concatenate([arr[1:] for arr in list_of_ages_single_epoch if len(arr) > 1])
    if any(len(arr) > 1 for arr in list_of_ages_single_epoch)
    else np.array([], dtype=np.float64)
)
non_spine_age_samples_three = (
    np.concatenate([arr[1:] for arr in list_of_ages_three_epoch if len(arr) > 1])
    if any(len(arr) > 1 for arr in list_of_ages_three_epoch)
    else np.array([], dtype=np.float64)
)
non_spine_age_samples_lifespans = (
    np.concatenate([arr[1:] for arr in list_of_ages_lifespans if len(arr) > 1])
    if any(len(arr) > 1 for arr in list_of_ages_lifespans)
    else np.array([], dtype=np.float64)
)
non_spine_age_samples_all = (
    np.concatenate(
        [arr[1:] for arr in list_of_ages_single_epoch if len(arr) > 1]
        + [arr[1:] for arr in list_of_ages_three_epoch if len(arr) > 1]
        + [arr[1:] for arr in list_of_ages_lifespans if len(arr) > 1],
    )
    if (
        any(len(arr) > 1 for arr in list_of_ages_single_epoch)
        or any(len(arr) > 1 for arr in list_of_ages_three_epoch)
        or any(len(arr) > 1 for arr in list_of_ages_lifespans)
    )
    else np.array([], dtype=np.float64)
)
non_spine_prop_not_at_max = proportion_not_at_upper(
    non_spine_age_samples_all, time_span
)

non_spine_grid_single, non_spine_kde_single = boundary_corrected_kde_on_support(
    non_spine_age_samples_single,
    support_upper=time_span,
)
non_spine_grid_three, non_spine_kde_three = boundary_corrected_kde_on_support(
    non_spine_age_samples_three,
    support_upper=time_span,
)
non_spine_grid_lifespans, non_spine_kde_lifespans = boundary_corrected_kde_on_support(
    non_spine_age_samples_lifespans,
    support_upper=time_span,
)


def _non_spine_log_lik(age: float) -> float:
    return calculate_non_spine_ages_log_lik(
        birth_rates=birth_rate, death_rates=death_rate, ages=age, times=time_span
    )


non_spine_theory_x, non_spine_theory_y = theoretical_age_density(
    _non_spine_log_lik,
    time_span,
    proportion_not_at_upper=non_spine_prop_not_at_max,
)
spine_grid_single, spine_kde_single = boundary_corrected_kde_on_support(
    spine_age_samples_single,
    support_upper=time_span,
)
spine_grid_three, spine_kde_three = boundary_corrected_kde_on_support(
    spine_age_samples_three,
    support_upper=time_span,
)
spine_grid_lifespans, spine_kde_lifespans = boundary_corrected_kde_on_support(
    spine_age_samples_lifespans,
    support_upper=time_span,
)


def _spine_log_lik(age: float) -> float:
    return calculate_spine_ages_log_lik(
        birth_rates=birth_rate, death_rates=death_rate, ages=age, times=time_span
    )


spine_theory_x, spine_theory_y = theoretical_age_density(
    _spine_log_lik,
    time_span,
    include_endpoint=False,
    proportion_not_at_upper=spine_prop_not_at_max,
)

non_spine_y_max = robust_y_max(
    [
        non_spine_kde_single,
        non_spine_kde_three,
        non_spine_kde_lifespans,
        non_spine_theory_y,
    ]
)
spine_y_max = robust_y_max(
    [spine_kde_single, spine_kde_three, spine_kde_lifespans, spine_theory_y]
)


def _kde_panel(
    kde_x: np.ndarray | None,
    kde_y: np.ndarray | None,
    theory_x: np.ndarray,
    theory_y: np.ndarray,
    color: str,
    panel_title: str,
    x_label: str,
    y_label: str,
    y_domain: list[float],
) -> alt.LayerChart:
    x_dom = [0.0, float(time_span)]
    layers: list[alt.Chart] = []
    if kde_x is not None and kde_y is not None:
        kde_df = pd.DataFrame({"Age": kde_x.tolist(), "Density": kde_y.tolist()})
        layers.append(
            alt.Chart(kde_df)
            .mark_area(
                opacity=0.4, color=color, line={"color": color, "strokeWidth": 2}
            )
            .encode(
                x=alt.X("Age:Q", title=x_label, scale=alt.Scale(domain=x_dom)),
                y=alt.Y("Density:Q", title=y_label, scale=alt.Scale(domain=y_domain)),
            )
        )
    theory_df = pd.DataFrame({"Age": theory_x.tolist(), "Density": theory_y.tolist()})
    layers.append(
        alt.Chart(theory_df)
        .mark_line(strokeDash=[4, 2], color=PTOLQUAL[1], strokeWidth=2)
        .encode(
            x=alt.X("Age:Q", scale=alt.Scale(domain=x_dom)),
            y=alt.Y("Density:Q", scale=alt.Scale(domain=y_domain)),
        )
    )
    return alt.layer(*layers).properties(title=panel_title, width=280, height=200)


ns_dom = [0.0, non_spine_y_max]
sp_dom = [0.0, spine_y_max]
fig_summary = alt.vconcat(
    alt.hconcat(
        _kde_panel(
            non_spine_grid_single,
            non_spine_kde_single,
            non_spine_theory_x,
            non_spine_theory_y,
            PTOLQUAL[0],
            "Single-epoch process",
            "Age (single-epoch process)",
            "Density (non-spine)",
            ns_dom,
        ),
        _kde_panel(
            non_spine_grid_three,
            non_spine_kde_three,
            non_spine_theory_x,
            non_spine_theory_y,
            PTOLQUAL[2],
            "Three-epoch process",
            "Age (three-epoch process)",
            "",
            ns_dom,
        ),
        _kde_panel(
            non_spine_grid_lifespans,
            non_spine_kde_lifespans,
            non_spine_theory_x,
            non_spine_theory_y,
            PTOLQUAL[3],
            "Lifespan-at-birth",
            "Age (lifespan-at-birth)",
            "",
            ns_dom,
        ),
    ),
    alt.hconcat(
        _kde_panel(
            spine_grid_single,
            spine_kde_single,
            spine_theory_x,
            spine_theory_y,
            PTOLQUAL[0],
            "Single-epoch process",
            "Age (single-epoch process)",
            "Density (spine)",
            sp_dom,
        ),
        _kde_panel(
            spine_grid_three,
            spine_kde_three,
            spine_theory_x,
            spine_theory_y,
            PTOLQUAL[2],
            "Three-epoch process",
            "Age (three-epoch process)",
            "",
            sp_dom,
        ),
        _kde_panel(
            spine_grid_lifespans,
            spine_kde_lifespans,
            spine_theory_x,
            spine_theory_y,
            PTOLQUAL[3],
            "Lifespan-at-birth",
            "Age (lifespan-at-birth)",
            "",
            sp_dom,
        ),
    ),
).properties(
    title="Age Densities by Generator (Single-Epoch vs Three-Epoch vs Lifespan-at-birth)"
)
display(fig_summary)
save_chart(fig_summary, "vme01_age_densities", output_dir=figures_dir)
print("Saved age-density figure")
```

The density of the spine age distribution does not include the point mass at the maximum time span.

## Statistical Goodness-of-Fit Tests

```{python}
SIMULATION_SEED = 33943  # fixed seed for permutation test reproducibility

ad_method = PermutationMethod(
    n_resamples=1_111, batch=101, rng=np.random.default_rng(SIMULATION_SEED)
)

# Spine: single-epoch vs three-epoch (main consistency check)
spine_ad_single_three = anderson_ksamp(
    [spine_age_samples_single, spine_age_samples_three],
    variant="midrank",
    method=ad_method,
)
# Spine: single-epoch vs lifespan
spine_ad_single_lifespan: Any = None
if spine_age_samples_lifespans.size > 0:
    spine_ad_single_lifespan = anderson_ksamp(
        [spine_age_samples_single, spine_age_samples_lifespans],
        variant="midrank",
        method=PermutationMethod(
            n_resamples=1_111,
            batch=101,
            rng=np.random.default_rng(SIMULATION_SEED + 1),
        ),
    )

# Non-spine: asymptotic (large N makes permutation test redundant)
non_spine_ad_single_three: Any = None
if non_spine_age_samples_single.size > 0 and non_spine_age_samples_three.size > 0:
    non_spine_ad_single_three = anderson_ksamp(
        [non_spine_age_samples_single, non_spine_age_samples_three],
        variant="midrank",
    )
non_spine_ad_single_lifespan: Any = None
if non_spine_age_samples_single.size > 0 and non_spine_age_samples_lifespans.size > 0:
    non_spine_ad_single_lifespan = anderson_ksamp(
        [non_spine_age_samples_single, non_spine_age_samples_lifespans],
        variant="midrank",
    )

# Population distributions
pop_ad_single_three = anderson_ksamp(
    [population_sizes_single_epoch, population_sizes_three_epoch],
    variant="midrank",
    method=PermutationMethod(
        n_resamples=1_111, batch=101, rng=np.random.default_rng(SIMULATION_SEED + 2)
    ),
)
pop_ad_single_lifespan = anderson_ksamp(
    [population_sizes_single_epoch, population_sizes_lifespans],
    variant="midrank",
    method=PermutationMethod(
        n_resamples=1_111, batch=101, rng=np.random.default_rng(SIMULATION_SEED + 3)
    ),
)

# KS tests
spine_ks_st, spine_ks_st_p = ks_2samp(spine_age_samples_single, spine_age_samples_three)
spine_ks_sl, spine_ks_sl_p = (
    ks_2samp(spine_age_samples_single, spine_age_samples_lifespans)
    if spine_age_samples_lifespans.size > 0
    else (None, None)
)
non_spine_ks_st = (
    ks_2samp(non_spine_age_samples_single, non_spine_age_samples_three)
    if (non_spine_age_samples_single.size > 0 and non_spine_age_samples_three.size > 0)
    else (None, None)
)
non_spine_ks_sl = (
    ks_2samp(non_spine_age_samples_single, non_spine_age_samples_lifespans)
    if (
        non_spine_age_samples_single.size > 0
        and non_spine_age_samples_lifespans.size > 0
    )
    else (None, None)
)
pop_ks_st, pop_ks_st_p = ks_2samp(population_sizes_single_epoch, population_sizes_three_epoch)
pop_ks_sl, pop_ks_sl_p = ks_2samp(population_sizes_single_epoch, population_sizes_lifespans)

print("=" * 70)
print("ANDERSON-DARLING TESTS (Single-Epoch vs Three-Epoch)")
print("=" * 70)
print("\nSpine Ages:")
print(f"  AD statistic: {spine_ad_single_three.statistic:.6f}")
print(f"  p-value: {spine_ad_single_three.pvalue:.6f}")
if non_spine_ad_single_three is not None:
    print("\nNon-Spine Ages:")
    print(f"  AD statistic: {non_spine_ad_single_three.statistic:.6f}")
    print(f"  p-value: {non_spine_ad_single_three.pvalue:.6f}")
print("\nPopulation Distributions:")
print(f"  AD statistic: {pop_ad_single_three.statistic:.6f}")
print(f"  p-value: {pop_ad_single_three.pvalue:.6f}")

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("ANDERSON-DARLING TESTS (Single-Epoch vs Lifespan-at-birth)")
print("=" * 70)
if spine_ad_single_lifespan is not None:
    print("\nSpine Ages:")
    print(f"  AD statistic: {spine_ad_single_lifespan.statistic:.6f}")
    print(f"  p-value: {spine_ad_single_lifespan.pvalue:.6f}")
if non_spine_ad_single_lifespan is not None:
    print("\nNon-Spine Ages:")
    print(f"  AD statistic: {non_spine_ad_single_lifespan.statistic:.6f}")
    print(f"  p-value: {non_spine_ad_single_lifespan.pvalue:.6f}")
print("\nPopulation Distributions:")
print(f"  AD statistic: {pop_ad_single_lifespan.statistic:.6f}")
print(f"  p-value: {pop_ad_single_lifespan.pvalue:.6f}")

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("KOLMOGOROV-SMIRNOV TESTS")
print("=" * 70)
print("\nSpine Ages (single vs three):")
print(f"  KS statistic: {spine_ks_st:.6f}")
print(f"  p-value: {spine_ks_st_p:.6f}")
if spine_ks_sl is not None:
    print("\nSpine Ages (single vs lifespan):")
    print(f"  KS statistic: {spine_ks_sl:.6f}")
    print(f"  p-value: {spine_ks_sl_p:.6f}")
if non_spine_ks_st[0] is not None:
    print("\nNon-Spine Ages (single vs three):")
    print(f"  KS statistic: {non_spine_ks_st[0]:.6f}")
    print(f"  p-value: {non_spine_ks_st[1]:.6f}")
if non_spine_ks_sl[0] is not None:
    print("\nNon-Spine Ages (single vs lifespan):")
    print(f"  KS statistic: {non_spine_ks_sl[0]:.6f}")
    print(f"  p-value: {non_spine_ks_sl[1]:.6f}")
print("\nPopulation Distributions (single vs three):")
print(f"  KS statistic: {pop_ks_st:.6f}")
print(f"  p-value: {pop_ks_st_p:.6f}")
print("\nPopulation Distributions (single vs lifespan):")
print(f"  KS statistic: {pop_ks_sl:.6f}")
print(f"  p-value: {pop_ks_sl_p:.6f}")
```

All three generators (single-epoch process, three-epoch process with constant rates,
lifespan-at-birth three-epoch) should be statistically indistinguishable under these
tests when correctly implemented.
